featured_reviews.name: Seerat Gill
featured_reviews.review_text:
Participating in MUNs has become one of my favorite hobbies, and honestly, some of my best experiences have been at events organized by Edxcursions. They make the whole process so much smoother. What I appreciate the most is how accessible they are—as delegates, we can reach out directly with any doubts, which is so helpful.
Every event feels fresh because they always introduce new ways to keep students engaged from day one. From the quality of the food to the standard of the committee sessions, everything is always on point. I’ll never forget that my very first MUN was also organised by Edxcursions itself; while I often hear other delegates say their first time was confusing, mine was clear and well-organized thanks to the team's hard work. A special thanks to Mr. Prashant, who is incredibly kind and always ready to help. Their registration process is also very fair and transparent. Truly a brilliant experience!

featured_reviews.name: Piyush Chilwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
As the Event In-Charge of DPSR MUN 2025 at Delhi Public School Rudrapur, I had the opportunity to work closely with Edxcursions for the first time, though I have been in professional contact with the Founder & CEO Mr Prashant Nagpal for the past 4–5 years.

From an organiser’s perspective, the experience was extremely smooth and reassuring. The Edxcursions team demonstrated exceptional professionalism, academic clarity, and operational efficiency throughout the planning and execution of the conference. Their structured approach, prompt communication, and understanding of school-level requirements made the collaboration seamless.

The leadership behind Edxcursions deserves special mention—vision-driven, calm under pressure, and genuinely focused on student learning and delegate experience. DPSR MUN 2025 turned into a well-coordinated and academically enriching event, and Edxcursions played a crucial role in its success.

I highly recommend Edxcursions to schools and institutions looking for reliable, high-quality academic collaborations. Looking forward to many more successful associations in the future.

featured_reviews.name: Shubham Pal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Edexcursion under its founder is one of the pioneer institutions working in the field of education and experiential learning. The dedication, purposefulness and resources of the team have imparted skills, exposure and a learning experience for thousands of youngsters in the country and around the globe.
The conferences showcase a professional and ethical work culture and the committee sessions with their structured methodologies allow the participants to think out of boxes to deliver effective solutions for the present global and national issues facing the society.
The energy, zeal, competitive spirit and deliberations shown by the participants gives us hope that the young leaders of today will transform the societies into sustainable development engines with their informed choices.
The committee sessions, socials and networkings have left a lasting impression on the minds of the students and educational communities and a promise to set the best standards in hosting the MUN conferences.

I was invited to be a speaker at multiple events which ensbled me to intract with youth and share insights on leveraging people , methodology  and learning principals. well done !!

featured_reviews.name: DeepthiJayasankar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Education today isn't just about memorizing facts or acing exams-it's about preparing students for a dynamic, ever-changing world. And that's exactly what Edxcursions does so well. It takes learning beyond the classroom, immersing students in experiences that challenge them to think critically, collaborate effectively, and engage with global issues in meaningful ways. At its core, EdXcursions foster skills that students will carry into their futures- research, public speaking, negotiation, and problem-solving, just to name a few. Edxcursions excels at this by creating an environment where students don't just learn about global affairs; they step into the shoes of world leaders, grappling with real-world challenges, debating policies, and crafting solutions that mirror the complexities of international relations.

What sets Edxcursions apart is its commitment to active, student-driven learning. This isn't about passively absorbing information - it's about students shaping their own learning experiences. They research, analyze, and present arguments, developing the kind of confidence and adaptability that will serve them well in any career path they choose. Whether it's through expertly curated training sessions, high-quality conferences, or mentorship from experienced MUN professionals, students are equipped not only to succeed in MUN but to grow as leaders and changemakers.Beyond just the debates and resolutions, Edxcursions nurtures a sense of global citizenship. Students walk away with a deeper understanding of international issues, a heightened awareness of different perspectives, and, perhaps most importantly, the ability to engage in respectful, solution-oriented discussions- something the world could certainly use more. If you're looking for an institution that understands that education today is about more than rote learning-that it's about discovery, exploration, and real-world application Edxcursions  is a name to remember. It's MUN done right: immersive, engaging, and transformative.

featured_reviews.name: Sony Gill
featured_reviews.review_text: It was completely a mesmerizing experience where we learnt, met new people, had fun dancing at the end of the second day and the meal was delicious. The delegates and chair persons were nice and kind. Spending these 3 days in LS MUN, Kashipur was so memorable for me and I would always love to participate again in the future.
